;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Street battles between anti-government protesters and riot police in [[Sudan]] leave at least 19 people dead, including two [[Law enforcement in Sudan|policemen]], as well as hundreds injured. [[Amnesty International]] puts the death toll at 37. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/sudan-government-19-killed-200-injured-protests-181227191854282.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Richard Arvin Overton]], the oldest U.S. veteran from [[World War II]], as well as the oldest American man, dies at age 112. [https://www.newsweek.com/americas-oldest-living-world-war-ii-veteran-richard-overton-dies-112-1273249?amp=1 (Newsweek)], [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2018/12/27/us/richard-overton-oldest-ww-ii-vet-died/index.html (CNN)]
* [[Argentina]] lifts a travel ban on Canadian singer [[Justin Bieber]], who had been previously banned from the country for his role in the beating of a photographer in November 2013. A Document of Resolution was signed last week, officially ending Bieber's ban, so Bieber may now freely return to the country. [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-6533603/Justin-Bieber-free-return-Argentina-Supreme-Court-clears-2013-attack-snapper.html (''Daily Mail'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*The [[New York City]] sky lights up in blue after a transformer in [[Astoria, Queens]], explodes. [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/dec/28/new-york-sky-bright-blue-lights-explosion-astoria-power-plant-queens (''The Guardian'')], [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/Blue-Light-Sky-Explosion-Queens-503589291.html?amp=y (NBC New York)] 

;International relations
*[[Iraq–United States relations]]
**[[Iraq]]i politicians from both [[List of political parties in Iraq|parliamentary blocs]] in the [[Council of Representatives of Iraq]] demand the withdrawal of [[United States|U.S.]] forces from the country, following [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s unannounced visit to troops stationed at [[Al Asad Airbase]]. An extraordinary session to debate the matter is planned. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/27/iraq-trump-visit-us-troops-lawmakers-demand-leave (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Foreign relations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**The DRC government gives the European Union 48 hours to recall its envoy in the country after the EU imposed sanctions on 14 Congolese officials. [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2018/12/dr-congo-gives-eu-48-hours-to-withdraw-envoy/ (Vanguard News Nigeria)]

;Law and crime
*Five [[Christian monasticism|Christian monks]] are tied up and then left injured, one of them seriously, after a robbery at a church in [[Vienna]], [[Austria]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/27/manhunt-after-monks-injured-in-church-robbery-in-vienna (''The Guardian'')]
